steps.en: Daily court updates arrive from State Courts
steps.id: Update harian pengadilan diterima dari State Courts
steps.why_en: No State Courts interface exists in any part of the system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada interface State Courts di bagian sistem mana pun.

steps.en: Each record is validated and matched to a notice
steps.id: Tiap record divalidasi dan dicocokkan ke notice
steps.why_en: No code reads or validates court adjudication records.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang membaca atau memvalidasi record adjudication.

steps.en: A new court mention date is added to the notice
steps.id: Tanggal court mention baru ditambahkan ke notice
steps.why_en: No place exists to store or update the mention date.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tempat untuk menyimpan atau mengubah tanggal mention.

steps.en: The court processing stage is updated from the result
steps.id: Court processing stage diubah sesuai hasil
steps.why_en: Only a different system (CAS) changes court stages; the State Courts result does not.
steps.why_id: Hanya sistem lain (CAS) yang mengubah stage court; hasil State Courts tidak.

steps.en: Officers see the updated court details on the notice
steps.id: Petugas melihat detail court terbaru di notice
steps.why_en: Nothing fills the court details, so there is nothing updated to show.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang mengisi detail court, jadi tidak ada yang diperbarui untuk ditampilkan.
